decisions.reason: A devoré line close to the core collection fits the firm's reorder-continuity promise, and with no evidence of a shortfall against aspirations, management would keep carrying it from stock.
Transparent burnout curtain fabric is a staple of the decoration range and costs little to keep in a stocked line, so no problemistic search is triggered.
A single burnout article overlaps with lines A and B, which makes it a likely candidate for range pruning, but without signs of underperformance it is kept for now.
Velour-like upholstery fabric extends the established upholstery offer with steady demand, and the firm's slack lets it be carried while its results become clear.
A flame-retardant plain fabric serves contract and retail buyers with lasting demand and certification value, so it likely meets aspirations.
Lining fabric is a basic complementary article that supports the made-to-measure sewing service and is cheap to keep in stock.
